title: Differential Testing of Monitor Models Against a Reference Oracle

original_idea.body:
# Differential Testing of Monitor Models Against a Reference Oracle

**Problem:** Different monitors disagree on suspicion, but we lack a way to find inputs where a cheap monitor diverges from a strong reference, the dangerous cases.

**Direction:** Import differential testing: run many cheap monitors and one strong reference over the same actions, surface every disagreement, then cluster to characterize cheap-monitor failure modes. The disagreement set becomes a targeted hard-case benchmark.

**Why it matters:** Cheaply mines the highest-value cases and characterizes when weak monitors fail, informing trusted-monitoring design. API-only, no training.

**Relevant context:** Csmith differential testing; Redwood AI Control 2023; arXiv:2511.02997.
